origin.description: Origin without userinfo, path, query or fragment. HTTP requires allowHttp: true.

file.description: Absolute local path; UNC and device paths are forbidden on Windows.

discovery.help:
awx-axi job list [--status <s>] [--type <t>] [--failed] [--since <time>] [--limit <n>]
Artium manages the HTTPS origin and token. Operational writes require administrator allowWrites and --confirm. Configuration, deletion and security writes are blocked. No stdin or files. Use job watch --timeout 50 or less.
